status: frozen before pilot and bootstrap draws
question: Does the source-family unweighted quadratic FSS describe the two fixed fresh local grids? Logistic rejection does not answer this.
model: Preserved normalized quadratic fit, five fixed exponent starts; no source values, new windows or new physical trials
statistic: Binomial deviance of counts from unweighted least-squares fitted probabilities
calibration: Parametric bootstrap from the fitted quadratic probabilities, refit identical estimator to each count draw. This plug-in model diagnostic is not exact finite-sample calibration or threshold coverage.
multiplicity: Two-model family, alpha0.05 Bonferroni: each model tested at0.025. Also report conservative0.005 sensitivity. Conditional on successful physical observed fit.
failures: Retain failed, boundary, nonphysical or nonmonotone bootstrap fits as unresolved calibration draws. Report p-value lower/upper bounds counting unresolved draws as none/all exceedances; do not discard or resample.
stopping: Fixed2000 draws, no sequential significance stopping. Report MonteCarlo Clopper-Pearson95percent bounds for exceedance lower/upper indicators. Reject only if upper uncertainty bound is below stated alpha; otherwise do not claim adequacy.
resources: Pilot20 refits per family; one worker, 2GiB address space and2400CPU seconds. If projected total exceeds1800seconds, stop and report cost before production; no silent sample reduction.
